scenarios.reasoning: The agent took a reasonable approach and identified the key error types and their concentration in HotReload test files. However, it missed a failing project and completely omitted the target framework information. The permission errors when trying to read the full error list hampered deeper analysis. The root cause analysis was reasonable but incomplete. Overall an acceptable but not thorough analysis.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files
